title: Operation Perla: 148 Arrested in Anti-Kidnapping and Extortion Sweep
detail: Police Gaula units and the Attorney General's Office arrested 148 people across six cities and 12 departments, including 19 ELN, 15 Clan del Golfo, 11 ACSN and 5 FARC-dissident members; 75 were held for extortion and 32 for kidnapping. Five suspected gang members (2 ELN, 3 FARC dissidents) were killed. Authorities seized 24 firearms, 12 grenades, 262 phones and a drone.

title: De la Espriella Reverses October Gasoline Price Increase
detail: President de la Espriella ordered Mines and Energy Minister María Nohemí Arboleda to cancel a planned ~COP 46/gallon (0.29%) October gasoline increase, one day after it was announced, while the government seeks alternatives for international oil-price pressure.
